feedback: Use the canonical QUDT unit IRI for every stress quantity: bind a unit prefix to <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/> and set sh:hasValue to unit:MegaPA. The current qudt:MegaPA expands under the QUDT schema namespace rather than the declared recommended unit IRI http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/MegaPA.

Repair the inverted validation logic: the datatype checks in the NOT EXISTS blocks currently require yield strength and stresses to be non-decimal, while the comparison blocks only evaluate non-decimal yield values. Require xsd:decimal values first, then reject any paired shear stress >= yieldStrength/sqrt(3) and any flange von Mises stress >= 1.15*yieldStrength, preserving the strict less-than direction. Remove the nonlinearCalculationMethodValue alternative; this requirement applies only when a calculation case has calculationMethod nltl:linearCalculationMethodValue, and missing selector evidence must violate rather than pass. Place bucklingCriteriaSatisfied on its declared hullStructure owner, not on structuralMember, and require the applicable web/flange buckling evidence rather than merely any member carrying true. Retain the canonical unit:MegaPA unit IRI and explicitly cover the declared calculation-case, structural-member/web/flange paths, operands, results, applicability, controlled value, and evidence boundary.
